item.title: Survey US alone in finding fellow citizens morally bad
item.description: Out of 25 countries, the United States was the only one where most people said their fellow citizens’ morality was generally bad, new research has found.

item.title: Public health s humble giant
item.description: I met Bill Foege only once in my life. My ten-minute conversation with the epidemiologist, who died in January at age 89, is one I’ll never forget.

item.title: Conservative Anglican bishops seek disengagement from Canterbury without naming rival leader
item.description: Weeks before Sarah Mullally is officially installed as the first female archbishop of Canterbury, a group of conservative Anglican prelates known as GAFCON renamed their body the Global Anglican Communion and elected a set of leaders to exercise “principled disengagement” from the archbishop and the historic center of Anglicanism in England.

item.title: On the Monumental Altarpiece of nbsp the Life of Christ and the Virgin nbsp Made for Pedro L pez de Ayala
item.description: Imagining that Spanish chapel whereThis altarpiece had stood five hundred years,Hearing a ringing sanctuary bellHurrying the family to their morning mass,I see them dip their fingertips in water,Cross themselves, and kneel on a cold stone floor.
